newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bourse hits new record high.
newsitem.headline: French bourse hits new record high.

text.p: The blue chip CAC-40 index of 40 leading French shares hit a new record high in late afternoon trade on Friday, rising 1.87 percent to touch 2,811.86 points before retracing slightly.
At 1432 GMT, it was trading at 2,805.99, up 1.66 percent.
The market was buoyed by optimism that a dispute over EU stability pact would be resolved as well as by by a weaker than expected U.S. producer price report.
